title: Compare
modelsCaption: Each selected model is independently backtested, then restarted over the exact shared completed holding periods. Comparison settings below are independent of the Backtest page. This is informational only and does not recommend one model.
savedCaption: Save portfolios on the Portfolio page first. Loading here does not change your default portfolio.
methodCaption: Daily valuation preserves each sleeve's trading schedule and lets weights drift. Required for A-RVol. Monthly resets are for monthly strategies only. USD sleeves only.
modelsGate: Select at least two models to compare.
portfoliosGate: Load at least two saved portfolios to compare.
contributionCaption: Added to every selected model each month, on top of the initial investment. 0 keeps a one-time lump sum.
dateOrder: Comparison start must not be after comparison end.
portfolioDateOrder: Start must not be after end.
dateRange: Dates must be inside the shared comparison window.
success: All results below use **{start} through {end}** ({n} complete monthly holding periods).
latest: Latest allocation in the shared period

downloads.after-tax-monthly-returns: Download common-period after-tax monthly returns CSV

closing: Every portfolio restarts with equal capital over the same observed dates. Fees and tax are computed independently. Tax is simplified; cross-sleeve loss offsets and terminal liquidation are not modeled in daily valuation.
mismatch: Compared models must use the same execution currency. No currency conversion is assumed.
unknownPortfolio: Choose saved portfolios from your signed-in library.
invalidSaved: Saved portfolio could not be loaded for comparison.
invalid: Check the comparison settings and try again.
progress: Loading public data and running the existing engines. No saved data is changed.
before: Choose at least two entries, then press Run comparison.
chartLimit: Chart series are reduced for display only; metrics, tax ledger and CSV downloads use every original row.
dateHelp: Blank dates use the full common window. Dates are checked when you run; they are not silently clamped.
neutral: Results use neutral Portfolio 1, Portfolio 2 labels in selection order. Saved names, library positions, IDs and FX are not stored in the shared cache.
hint: Selected models use different execution currencies. Compare requires the same execution currency; no currency conversion is assumed.
requestError: Comparison could not be loaded. Try again; no saved data has been changed.
unauthorized: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
timeout: This backtest took longer than the free plan allows (5 minutes). Try a shorter date range.
downloadError: Full download unavailable. Run the comparison again.
sizeError: Display response exceeds the size limit; try a shorter date range.
invalidResult: The engine returned no finite completed comparison.
cached: Loaded a matching public comparison result.
